```{r}
library(rvest)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
url <- "https://link.springer.com/search?facet-journal-id=12968&query=machine+learning&content-type=Article&dateFrom=&dateTo=&sortBy=relevance"

page <- read_html(url)

titles <- page |>
  html_elements("a.app-card-open__link") |>
  html_text()

titles

links <- page |>
  html_elements("a.app-card-open__link") |>
  html_attr("href")

links <- paste0("https://link.springer.com", links)

dates <- page |>
  html_elements(".app-card-open__meta") |>
  html_text()
dates_clean <- dates |>
  str_squish()
dates_clean <- dates_clean |>
  str_remove("Open access")
dates_clean <- dates_clean |>
  str_squish()
    
dates_clean

articles <- tibble(
  title = titles,
  date  = dates_clean,
  link  = links
)

articles
```
